body.statement: Sanity check: When \(P(X=0)=1\) and \(Z>0\) almost surely, the obstacle program collapses to the scalar interval for the common baseline trend and reproduces the bounded-conditional-average-slope WAOSS bounds of de Chaisemartin, Ciccia, D'Haultf\oe{}uille, and Knau (2024).
body.justification: This reduction is the required sanity check and fixes the boundary between prior art and the varying-baseline contribution.
body.gap: The scalar common-zero-baseline result is published; the proposition claims equivalence, not novelty.
body.consumer: Readers can verify that existing heterogeneous-adoption bounds are nested exactly within the new frontier.
